welcome.title: Welcome to XClaw
welcome.description: Your AI assistant is ready to be configured

welcome.title: Welcome to XClaw
welcome.description: XClaw is a graphical interface for OpenClaw, making it easy to use AI assistants across your favorite messaging platforms.

takeover.title: Existing OpenClaw Detected
takeover.description: You can adopt the current environment or continue with a fresh XClaw setup.

choice.takeoverDescription: Reuse the current OpenClaw providers, skills, and workspace state.
choice.freshDescription: Keep the current OpenClaw install and create a new default XClaw configuration.

mode.takeoverDescription: XClaw will import the current providers, workspace, and skill state so the app is ready to use immediately.
mode.freshDescription: The current OpenClaw install stays untouched. XClaw will suggest a non-conflicting workspace and gateway port.
mode.workspaceHint: XClaw will use this directory by default, and you can still change it later in Settings.
mode.portHint: If the current port is already used by OpenClaw, XClaw will guide you to a non-conflicting port.
mode.nextHint: Continue to the next step to confirm these defaults.

preparation.title: Prepare the current OpenClaw environment
preparation.description: Review what will be imported and any conflicts before the actual takeover starts.
preparation.pendingHint: XClaw starts the real takeover and import only after you choose Import and Continue.

takeover.running: Adopting and importing the current environment...

progress.backup: Backing up the current local XClaw state
progress.import: Importing OpenClaw providers and auth data
progress.commit: Committing takeover results and setup completion
progress.rollback: Takeover failed, rolling back local state

takeover.importFailed: Takeover failed. Resolve the blocking issue and try again.

providerReview.title: Review Imported Provider State
providerReview.description: Takeover is complete, but some imported provider state still needs your confirmation.
providerReview.nextHint: You can continue into the app now and fix these providers later in Settings.

setup.title: Fresh Runtime Settings
setup.description: Confirm the default workspace and gateway port before finishing setup.
setup.workspaceHint: Absolute paths and ~/... expansion are supported.
setup.portHint: Must be an integer between 1 and 65535.
setup.portInvalid: Gateway port must be an integer between 1 and 65535

status.packageDistMissing: OpenClaw package was found, but the dist build output is missing
status.gatewayWaiting: Waiting for the gateway to become ready...

summary.description: Confirm the runtime is ready before moving on to provider access.

issue.title: Environment issue detected
issue.desc: Please ensure OpenClaw is properly installed. Check the logs for details.

advanced.title: Advanced diagnostics
advanced.description: Keep the main flow focused on readiness. Logs, retries, and detailed runtime state live here.
advanced.descriptionOpen: Detailed diagnostics, runtime status, and log actions are currently visible.

provider.label: Model Provider
provider.modelIdDesc: The model identifier from your provider (e.g. deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3)
provider.storedLocally: Your API key is stored locally on your machine.

channel.title: Connect a Messaging Channel
channel.subtitle: Choose a platform to connect your AI assistant to. You can add more channels later in Settings.
channel.connectedDesc: Your channel has been configured. It will connect when the Gateway starts.

installing.title: Installing Essential Components
installing.subtitle: Setting up the tools needed to power your AI assistant
installing.wait: This may take a few moments...

complete.title: Setup Complete!
complete.subtitle: XClaw is configured and ready to use. You can now start chatting with your AI assistant.
complete.footer: You can customize skills and connect channels in Settings
complete.gatewayPendingHint: If the gateway is not running yet, XClaw will keep taking over the startup process after you enter the app.

preparation.label: Preparation
preparation.description: Check the environment and import readiness

complete.label: Finish
complete.description: Review the final summary and enter the app

start.title: Start setup
start.body: Choose how to begin before moving on to preparation and access.

preparation.title: Prepare the environment
preparation.body: Confirm local readiness before moving on to model access.

provider.title: Model access
provider.body: Choose the access method before continuing.

complete.title: Finish
complete.body: Confirm the changes and enter the app.

applying.title: Applying changes
applying.body: Keep this window open. The summary will appear automatically when everything is ready.

exitDialog.title: Exit setup now?
exitDialog.message: Leaving now will not mark setup as complete, and the wizard will return next time.
exitDialog.applyingTitle: Changes are still applying. Exit anyway?
exitDialog.applyingMessage: The current changes are not finished yet, and setup will not be marked as complete if you leave now.
